meta.name: imagegen-frontend-web
meta.description: Elite frontend image-direction skill for generating premium, conversion-aware website design references. CRITICAL OUTPUT RULE — generate ONE separate horizontal image FOR EVERY section. A landing page with 8 sections produces 8 images. Never compress multiple sections into one image. Enforces composition variety (not always left-text / right-image), background-image freedom, varied CTAs, varied hero scales (giant / mid / mini minimalist), narrative concept spine, second-read moments, and a single consistent palette across all images. Optimized for landing pages, marketing sites, and product comps that developers or coding models can accurately recreate.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网站每个区块生成高质量设计参考图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站每个区块生成风格统一的设计参考图
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-quality design reference images for each website section
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need design reference images for each section of a website

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为网站设计的每个部分（如导航栏、页脚）单独生成一张横向参考图，并确保各图风格统一、布局多样，避免重复。
howto.when: 当你要求生成落地页、营销网站或产品设计参考图时触发。默认一个落地页生成 6 张图，完整网站模板生成 8 张。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 产品的落地页，8 个部分。
say.note: Claude 会生成 8 张横向参考图，每张对应一个部分。

say.text: 生成一个极简风格的品牌首页，5 个部分。
say.note: Claude 会生成 5 张图，采用极简布局。

say.text: 为我的电商店铺设计一个产品页面，4 个部分。
say.note: Claude 会生成 4 张图，突出产品展示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates one separate horizontal reference image for each section of a website design (e.g., hero, features), ensuring consistent palette and varied layouts across all images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for landing pages, marketing sites, or product design references. Defaults to 6 images for a landing page, 8 for a full website template.

say_en.text: Design a SaaS landing page with 8 sections.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 8 horizontal images, one per section.

say_en.text: Create a minimalist brand homepage with 5 sections.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 5 images with minimalist layouts.

say_en.text: Design an e-commerce product page with 4 sections.
say_en.note: Claude will generate 4 images focused on product display.
